name: field
title: Field
description: Form controls that need a label, help text, and error.

motionProfile.reason: FieldContent owns one measured helper/error block while each message row, structure entry, display run and colour owner settles independently on its own host.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Field, FieldSet, FieldGroup and each message row own one insertion opacity; a presenting ancestor consumes the nested structure entrance.
The FieldSeparator rule keeps Separator's own insertion and orientation replacement.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A message row retained by its own presence scope fades out before the caller-owned completion removes it.
A removed rule keeps Separator's own exit instead of a second Field opacity channel.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: FieldContent owns the single measured message block and yields it to a focused editor, a caller clock or an unreadable destination.
The FieldSeparator rule keeps Separator's own explicit-length interpolation on its final orientation axis.

state.color/css-transition.reason: FieldLabel owns its surface and foreground together, and title, legend, description and error own their foreground; a focused editor or an invalid state settles them immediately.
The rule background belongs to the actual Separator child, never to the caption that masks it.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Plain label, title, legend, description, error and caption strings replace only their changed runs on one display host.

number.roll/reels.reason: A direct quantity in those same display parts reels its changed places; rich counters and identifiers stay text.
